Corresponding Source for Stockfish browser assets
=================================================

This directory (when published to /vendor/stockfish/) distributes GPL-3.0
object code together with the license text and corresponding source for the
exact binaries Procyon serves.

Distributed object code
-----------------------
- stockfish-18-lite-single.js
- stockfish-18-lite-single.wasm
- npm package: stockfish@18.0.8

License
-------
- Copying.txt (GNU GPL Version 3), colocated with the object code

Corresponding source archives (same origin, under source/)
----------------------------------------------------------
- stockfish.js-93c994592dcf3b4b21052ab925e9b534df9c0918.tar.gz
  Stockfish.js packaging and build sources matching the npm package gitHead
  for stockfish@18.0.8
  https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/93c994592dcf3b4b21052ab925e9b534df9c0918

- Stockfish-sf_18.tar.gz
  Official Stockfish engine sources at release tag sf_18
  (commit cb3d4ee9b47d0c5aae855b12379378ea1439675c)
  https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_18

These archives are offered from the same place as the object code so network
recipients have equivalent access to the corresponding source for the exact
distributed binaries.
